files.inspected_behavior: Generation 8+ updates Speed properties and re-sorts remaining queued moves after actions.

Tailwind doubles Speed for four turns; Trick Room has -7 priority, lasts five turns, and toggles off on reuse; Icy Wind and Electroweb have 55 base power, 95% accuracy and a one-stage Speed-lowering secondary effect.
Protosynthesis and Quark Drive persist the selected stat and apply a 1.5 multiplier only when that selected stat is Speed.

independent_mechanic_reference.source_url_limit: GitHub master URLs are navigable references, not pins; hashes identify the local source files actually inspected.

review_notes: Additional candidate pages were screened but not selected when the timeline lacked useful Speed control, duplicated an existing example, or used a custom Metronome-heavy ruleset.
A candidate displayed a PRIVATE label; it was excluded without inspecting or recording its battle timeline.
No new policy win-rate claim is supported by this qualitative review.
